create_continuous_tokenizer: create a ContinuousTokenizer with data mean, std, and statistics for normalizing trajectory data
create_tokenizer_from_dataset: create a ContinuousTokenizer from a training dataset using the create class method
encode_trajectory: encode a 3D trajectory tensor by normalizing and adding a token dimension
decode_trajectory: decode a 4D tokenized trajectory tensor back to denormalized 3D trajectory data
check_discrete_property: check the discrete property of ContinuousTokenizer which always returns False
